<details>
<summary>Prompt</summary>



```text
Create a portrait-oriented “秋日社区市集” poster featuring only:
“秋日社区市集”“新鲜抵达，邻里相见”
“2026.10.12”“上午10点—下午5点”.
The central composition must strictly feature three main subjects: a pumpkin, a canvas tote bag, and a leafy green vegetable.
Cream background; color palette of rust orange, forest green, and dark brown.
Do not add any other text, figures, logos, watermarks, produce, or decorative elements.
Arrange the four results vertically using four numbered modules, each containing a simple icon.
Cream-white background, dark coffee-brown text, and subtle orange accents.
All text must be clearly legible; do not add any other text, branding, logos, or watermarks.
```
